first.rationale: Run a tightly targeted promotional-pricing test for demonstrably price-sensitive SMB prospects, given active competitor entry pricing and prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift in that segment. Guard against low-quality or discount-dependent revenue by measuring qualified conversion, retention, expansion, and net revenue rather than signup volume alone. Verify the prior pricing record and the onboarding result before finalizing targeting and safeguards.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the self-serve onboarding flow. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, while the current declines in completion and activation make this the most direct sustainable-revenue intervention. The archived pricing result rules out discounting as a sustainable choice because its acquired cohort had materially worse retention. Measure completion, first meaningful action, qualified conversion, and 30-day retention to confirm the effect persists under current conditions.
